[[African Cricket Association]] | cricket format = [[Limited overs cricket]] | tournament format = [[Round-robin tournament|Round-robin]] | participants = 13 | champions = {{cr|Namibia}} | most runs = | most wickets = | previous_year = 2009 | previous_tournament = 2009 ICC Africa Under-19 Championships | next_year = | next_tournament = }} The '''2010 ICC Africa Under-19 Championships''' or '''2010 ICC Africa Under-19 World Cup Qualifiers''' were two [[cricket]] events organised by the [[African Cricket Association]]. The championships were played over two divisions and provided African U-19 teams with the chance to qualify for the [[2012 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup|2012 U-19 World Cup]]. The second division was held from 26 to 30 July in Big Bend, Swaziland[http://icc-cricket.yahoo.net/newsdetails.php?newsId=10357_1275288960 Venues for ICC Africa U19 CWCQ Division 2 confirmed] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120324120106/http://icc-cricket.yahoo.net/newsdetails.php?newsId=10357_1275288960 |date=24 March 2012 }} icc-cricket.yahoo.net 18 November 2010 and the first division from 29 August-5 September in [[Windhoek]], [[Namibia]].[http://icc-cricket.yahoo.net/newsdetails.php?newsId=11229_1282630560 Cricket Kenya Announces U19 Squad] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120324120114/http://icc-cricket.yahoo.net/newsdetails.php?newsId=11229_1282630560 |date=24 March 2012 }} icc-cricket.yahoo.net 18 November 2010 ==Division two== This was only the second playing of Division Two and it followed the same round-robin format as the previous year. The venue and dates were confirmed in May to be at Big Bend, a small village in the Lowveld region of Swaziland, from 26 to 30 July. All matches were played on three fields at and around the Ubombo Country Club. The winners would be promoted to the Division One Tournament.[http://icc-cricket.yahoo.net/newsdetails.php?newsId=10899_1280045400 Namibia announces squad for ICC Africa U19 CWCQ] extract: The 2010 ICC Africa Under-19 Championships or 2010 ICC Africa Under-19 World Cup Qualifiers were two cricket events organised by the African Cricket Association. The championships were played over two divisions and provided African U-19 teams with the chance to qualify for the 2012 U-19 World Cup. The second division was held from 26 to 30 July in Big Bend, Swaziland and the first division from 29 August-5 September in Windhoek, Namibia.
